verdict.rationale: Riveter's core product lets developers build enrichments/scrapes from a natural-language prompt (e.g., 'Research each company' with attributes) rather than writing CSS/XPath selectors, and its AI agents interpret pages 'the way a person would' so no selector maintenance is needed. This is documented across docs, blog, and SDK examples. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of extraction accuracy and no concrete benchmark comparing selector-free extraction quality vs traditional scrapers.
